name: manual_c908d1
claim: Before replaying a cross-repository lockstep plan, verify current merge and PR-head state; a historical plan can be accurate yet unsafe to replay after its delta already landed.

decisions.notes: The five-upload review found historical lockstep work already merged, so replay would have duplicated or conflicted with current behavior.

rationale: The five-upload review found historical lockstep work already merged, so replay would have duplicated or conflicted with current behavior.
